text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"—Town revitalization, huh... Maybe I 
should do something too..."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~~! Heave-ho~♪ Horse girls stompin'~~♪ 
In the hot sprin~gs~~♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, collecting towels? They must be heavy 
soaking up all that water, yet your voice 
is full of energy. You're certainly 
working hard.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you very much. I hope we weren't 
too loud?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all~ Echoing across the sky 
feels so nice. It makes me want to sing 
along♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, apparently back in the day, even 
more people used to sing together.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
The origins of the bath-treading song date 
back to long ago—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"While the Umamusume of this region were 
running and singing in a circle... A hot 
spring supposedly erupted right from the 
center of the ring!"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"And then, wishing for the prosperity of 
the hot spring resort, the Umamusume began 
playing together in the shallow waters..."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
It is said that this is how the 
"Bath-Treading Song" was born.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ever since, people in this region would 
sing together whenever doing work related 
to hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, so such a wonderful history is how the 
tradition was born.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, though at this point, I'm 
basically the only one who sings it.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Something that once nearly faded away with 
time was somehow preserved in records by 
the proprietress.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh... A hot water-treading song sung by a 
huge crowd must have been quite lively, 
wouldn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! That's it...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, young proprietress. Don't you think 
showcasing traditions like that could help 
revitalize the town too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And, the plan that Wonder Acute came up 
with is—!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all, the tradition returns! 
The 'Yufumi Foot-Bathing Show' is about to 
begin~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How do I look, Trainer-san? This outfit! 
The young proprietress dressed me in it 
since I'm the 'organizer'.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In other words... *I'm* the "leeeader"! 
Fuhooo-!!
choice_data_list: It really suits you! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text:
"This'll be my first time seeing a hot 
spring treading show~! I hear it has 
unique songs and steps...! Ooh, how 
charming~~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, the crowd sure has high hopes 
for us."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Everyooone! Are you all ready?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeees!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...♪ To think I'd be doing this 
together with everyone. ...*Deep breath*.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Yu~~~koma, what a wonderful place~~♪ —The 
water is so nice and warm~~♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~ Yum yum!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yukoma Onseeeen~~♪ Hyoi-ya! Soi-soi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash! Splash! Thud! Ba-dump!)

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the steam is...♪ You keep rhythm with 
your feet! It's so powerful~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The powerful singing voices and footsteps 
of the Umamusume made the earth and the 
very air tremble...!

text_block_list.name: Sound of Foot Bathing
text_block_list.text:
(Splash! Splash! Thud! Ba-dump!) (Haa~~♪ 
Pyoi-ya♪ Soi-soi♪)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The steam billows high into the air. 
Moistening the dry mountain air and the 
trees... the impact reverberates through 
the ground, spreading deep into the 
mountains...!"

text_block_list.name: Sound of Foot Bathing
text_block_list.text:
(Dan! Da-dan! Mowa-mowa... !) (Haa~~♪ 
Pyoi-ya♪ Soi-soi!♪)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Creak... creak... crack...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's that sound...? It seems quite 
noisy towards the mountains...?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I can hear it. A sound so faint that 
likely only an Umamusume could pick it 
up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Ruuuuumble...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous roar echoed from afar. I can 
feel the rumble of the earth through the 
soles of my shoes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*RUUUUUUUUMBLE—!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then...! A pillar of rainbow-colored 
light rose against the mountain slope. No, 
wait. That's not light. That's—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhooo!! Well, that blew me away!!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
What in the world is that?! Is it a 
reflection? Even so, what kind of 
components would make such a color...?!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: However, that color...! This aroma...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Proprietress~~~! Ah, there you are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where I caught up, clear hot water was 
trickling up from the ground.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, what beautiful hot water. And such a 
mysterious scent. Up close, it isn't 
rainbow-colored, though.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've never seen a hot spring source 
like this before...! Just one drop is 
enough to feel its exquisite, silky 
texture on the skin!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! Ahahaha! I never imagined 
something like this actually existed!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! It's a miracle! So the 
legendary hidden hot spring really did 
exist.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
It's still just a small spring, but at 
this rate, if we dig deeper...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Aargh...! Good grief, what a mess.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Even though you never showed up once back 
when Yunohana was an active racer!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you're right! It's a little 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Still... isn't this also because you kept 
doing your best here all this time, 
Landlady?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"The bath-treading song... Had it not been 
for the proprietress, it likely would have 
faded away, wouldn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hah...! Good grief... Tradition really is 
something to be treasured.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Let's work it to the absolute 
bone♪ For the sake of the girls who come 
after us!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Way ahead of you. Now, let's take it back 
and analyze the ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truly, many a true word is spoken in 
jest... Or rather, truth is stranger than 
fiction...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The “rainbow-colored secret spring that 
cures all ailments.” The origin of that 
legend turned out to be an embellished 
tale of the landlady's exploits...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However! The ultimate origin of the legend 
lay in the ancient "Hot Spring Stepping 
Song." That is why it has all connected 
here today...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Woah, talk about serendipity! Of course it 
probably won't cure *everything*, but a 
hidden hot spring with the finest waters 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a miracle born from history! The 
feelings of so many years, slowly 
accumulated...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Such a miracle—!
